entities.summary: Surendra Verma is a leading Hindi litterateur and playwright. He started out as a playwright, when his play Surya Ki Antim Kiran Se Surya Ki Pahli Kiran Tak became quite well known; it has been translated into six Indian languages. He has had a long association with the National School of Drama and has published about fifteen titles of short stories, satires, novels and plays.
